response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM p), r AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.avg_pt, p.avg_diff, p.avg_diff * 1.0 / m.overall_mean AS ratio FROM p CROSS JOIN m) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r GROUP BY SEX
